summary: The raport page and report components deliver a clear, Romanian-language structure with seven sections and PDF download. Main improvement areas: (1) accessibility—multiple h1s (Breadcrumb + ReportHeader), no section ids or aria-labelledby, decorative icons missing aria-hidden; (2) UX redundancy—Section 1 (truncated reasoning) and Section 2 (full reasoning) repeat the same content; (3) code—topRecommendations computed in four places, inline styles instead of design tokens; (4) PDF—breadcrumb selector mismatch (`.breadcrumb-area` vs `bd-breadcrumb-area`), and AgeGuidance alerts (success/warning) hidden by `.alert:not(.alert-info)`; (5) copy—CTAs should align with COPY_LIBRARY.

issues: Build placeholder renders user-visible 'Build placeholder' text; consider hiding or using neutral message.
Main report content wrapper has no semantic <main> landmark or aria-label for screen readers.
BreadcrumbOne renders h1 ('Raport Complet'); ReportHeader also renders h1 ('Raport Complet Personalizat')—multiple h1s violate a11y best practices.
improvements: Wrap report <section> in <main> with aria-label='Conținut raport' and ensure single h1 per page (e.g. demote Breadcrumb title to p or use ReportHeader as sole h1).
Change build placeholder text to something non-user-facing or remove it from production build output.

issues: No child name or personalization; header feels generic despite 'Personalizat'.
Inline style borderTop: '4px solid #00BBAE'—should use CSS class or design token.
Icons (bi-calendar3, bi-check-circle) lack aria-hidden; they are decorative.
Shows total quiz recommendations count (e.g. 7) while only top 3 are displayed in sections—potentially confusing.
improvements: Replace inline border with utility/SCSS class using --yuvoo-primary; add aria-hidden='true' to decorative icons.
Clarify header copy (e.g. 'Top 3 recomandări afișate' or show top count) or add child name when available from quiz/child data.
Ensure single h1 on page: either Breadcrumb title is not h1 on report route, or ReportHeader uses h2.

issues: Reasoning truncated at 120 chars with '...'; can cut mid-word and feels arbitrary.
minHeight: 60px on preview creates empty space when reasoning is short or missing.
Inline styles (fontSize, height, width) instead of CSS classes.
Progress bar has role='progressbar' but represents match score, not loading; consider aria-valuetext for clarity.
No section id for in-page navigation or aria-labelledby.
improvements: Truncate at word boundary (e.g. last space before 120 chars) or use CSS line-clamp; remove fixed minHeight.
Move inline styles to report-pdf.scss or utility classes; use design tokens.
Add id='sporturi-recomandate', aria-labelledby on section linking to h2.
Add aria-valuetext='{matchScore}% potrivire' to progress bar for screen readers.

issues: Duplicates reasoning already shown in SportRecommendationsSection (Section 1 truncates, Section 2 shows full)—redundant.
Generic fallback 'Acest sport este potrivit...' is identical for every sport when reasoning missing.
No section id for in-page nav.
improvements: Consider merging with Section 1 (show full reasoning in one place) or reframe Section 2 to add unique value (e.g. 'Ce spune profilul' vs 'De ce potrivit') to avoid pure duplication.
If keeping both, add id='de-ce-potrivite', aria-labelledby; improve fallback to reference sport name.

issues: Generic fallback benefits (Dezvoltare Fizică/Emoțională lists) are identical for every sport when AI provides no benefits.
Considerations use key={index}; prefer stable key if available.
Inline style borderLeft: '4px solid #00BBAE'.
No section id.
improvements: Replace inline border with CSS class; add id='ce-dezvolta', aria-labelledby.
When using fallback benefits, consider at least varying order or one sport-specific line if possible; use key from benefit text or sportId+index to avoid React key warnings.

issues: Uses only first consideration; reasoning or multiple considerations could be more informative.
Filter excludes top recommendations AND matchScore < 50; 'avoid' list is low-match sports only—logic is fine but could be documented.
No section id.
improvements: When showing 'sports to avoid', use reasoning or concatenate multiple considerations (with length limit) when available; fallback to current generic copy.
Add id='sporturi-de-evitata', aria-labelledby.

issues: canStart = childAge >= 5, waitMonths = childAge < 5 ? 6 : 0—same rule for all sports; no per-sport age logic.
'Semne de urmărit' list is generic for every sport; not personalized.
Recomputes topRecommendations (sort + slice); duplicated in ReportContent, NextSteps, LocalClubs.
No section id.
improvements: Add id='varsta-ideala', aria-labelledby. Pass topRecommendations as prop from ReportContent to avoid recomputation.
Keep age logic as-is unless product requests per-sport rules; optionally add brief comment documenting that age guidance is global.

issues: Recomputes topRecommendations; duplicated logic.
'Explorează Cluburi Locale' vs COPY_LIBRARY 'Explorează toate cluburile' / 'Explorează cluburile'—minor alignment.
Uses row gap-4; Bootstrap row gap utilities may vary—verify layout.
No section id.
improvements: Receive topRecommendations as prop; add id='pasi-urmatori', aria-labelledby.
Align CTA with COPY_LIBRARY: e.g. 'Explorează cluburile' or 'Explorează toate cluburile'.

issues: getCityIdByName can fail; no try/catch or error handling.
Recomputes topRecommendations; location parsing (split by comma) is fragile for unusual formats.
'Vezi Toate Cluburile' vs COPY_LIBRARY 'Vezi cluburile' / 'Explorează toate cluburile'.
No section id.
improvements: Wrap getCityIdByName in try/catch; log and degrade gracefully (cityId null) on failure.
Pass topRecommendations as prop; add id='cluburi-locale', aria-labelledby.
Align CTAs with COPY_LIBRARY.

issues: Button has no explicit aria-label (relies on visible text—acceptable but could improve).
Loading state uses role='status'; error alert could use aria-live or aria-describedby for dynamic updates.
Spinner has aria-hidden='true'; ensure 'Se pregătește...' is announced (e.g. aria-live on wrapper).
improvements: Add aria-busy when loading; ensure error alert has role='alert' (already has role='alert') and consider aria-live='polite' for error region so SR users hear updates.
Optional: aria-label='Descarcă raportul în format PDF' for clarity when icon+text might be unclear.

issues: Returns null; users relying on screen readers get no feedback during redirect.
No visible or announced 'Redirecting...' state.
improvements: Add visually hidden, aria-live='polite' element with text 'Se redirecționează...' before redirect, or a minimal skip-link placeholder so SR users know navigation is in progress.

issues: Footer note is a div with card classes, not semantic <footer>.
No explicit medical/non-diagnostic disclaimer (raport is recommendations, not medical advice)—could strengthen clarity.
improvements: Use <footer> with aria-label='Informații raport' or similar; keep existing copy.
Optional: add one short sentence that recommendations are informative only and not a substitute for professional advice, in Romanian—align with legal/medical guidelines.

issues: Print hides .breadcrumb-area; BreadcrumbOne uses .bd-breadcrumb-area—selector mismatch, breadcrumb may not hide in PDF.
.report-section .alert:not(.alert-info) hidden—AgeGuidance uses alert-success and alert-warning; those alerts are hidden in PDF, removing 'Poate începe acum' / 'Recomandăm să aștepți' content.
Duplicate page-break rules for .card and section.
.pdf-mode hides .btn globally; download button already hidden via d-none when isPdfMode—redundant but not harmful.
improvements: Add .bd-breadcrumb-area to print hide list (or fix selector) so breadcrumb is hidden in PDF.

Narrow alert hiding: hide only alerts that are purely UI (e.g. error alerts), not AgeGuidance content. Use a specific class for 'hide-in-pdf' on optional UI alerts, or exclude .alert-success and .alert-warning from the rule in report context.
Deduplicate page-break rules; keep single source.

issues: Two h1s on page: Breadcrumb 'Raport Complet' and ReportHeader 'Raport Complet Personalizat'.
No section ids or aria-labelledby; in-page navigation (e.g. 'on this page') not possible.
Decorative icons (bi-*) often lack aria-hidden.
Progress bar in SportRecommendationsSection represents match score, not progress; could use aria-valuetext.
ClientRedirect renders nothing; no SR feedback during redirect.
Main content has no <main> landmark.
improvements: Ensure single h1: use ReportHeader as primary h1; Breadcrumb title as p or span on report route.
Add id and aria-labelledby to each report section; consistent heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3).
Add aria-hidden='true' to all decorative icons in report components.
Add <main> wrapper with aria-label; add 'Se redirecționează...' for ClientRedirect.

issues: Section 1 (top sports + truncated reasoning) and Section 2 (full reasoning) duplicate content; second section adds little.
'Top X sporturi recomandate'—when X=1, 'sporturi' is plural; consider 'sport' for singular.
CTAs 'Explorează Cluburi Locale', 'Vezi Toate Cluburile' slightly differ from COPY_LIBRARY.
NextSteps 'Cum să începi' is generic; not tailored to recommended sports.
LocalClubs generic copy per sport; no sport-specific nuance.
improvements: Reduce redundancy: merge reasoning into one section or reframe Section 2 to add distinct value.
Use 'sport' when recommendations.length === 1, 'sporturi' otherwise.
Align CTAs with COPY_LIBRARY ('Explorează cluburile', 'Vezi cluburile' / 'Explorează toate cluburile').
Keep NextSteps/LocalClubs copy as-is unless product requests more personalization; document as future improvement.

issues: topRecommendations computed in ReportContent, AgeGuidance, NextSteps, LocalClubs (each sort+slice); DRY violation.
Inline styles (borderTop, borderLeft, fontSize, height, width, minHeight) across components; prefer CSS/design tokens.
LocalClubsSection: no try/catch around getCityIdByName.
Key=index in benefits/considerations lists; use sportId+index or stable key where possible.
ReportContent passes both sortedRecommendations and topRecommendations; some sections only need top.
improvements: Compute topRecommendations once in ReportContent; pass as prop to AgeGuidance, NextSteps, LocalClubs. Keep SportsToAvoidSection filter logic there but receive topRecommendations.
Replace inline styles with utility classes or report-specific SCSS using design tokens.
Add try/catch in LocalClubsSection for getCityIdByName; log and use cityId=null on failure.
Use key={sportId}-benefit-{index} or similar where sportId available.
